newsitem.title: UK: Freight market boosted by BFI breaking above 1,500.
newsitem.headline: Freight market boosted by BFI breaking above 1,500.

text.p: The spot Baltic Fright Index (BFI) burst through the 1,500 barrier today for the first time since Jan 31, up 25 points at 1,502.
Brokers said Panamax fixtures from the US Gulf took the limelight almost exclusively, with sharply higher rates on voyage and timecharter basis, both transatlantic and to the Far East.
But they expressed concern at the possible consequences of threatened Chinese retaliation against US grain exports in a long-running trade dispute over textiles.

Brokers reported a more promising tone in the Caper market, especially in the Atlantic. But with the possible exception of fixtures from the Continent little improvement in rates was seen for owners of handy-sizes.
GRAIN - Glencore conceded a substantial $16,000 daily plus $300,000 bonus for Stalo 73,000 tonne dwt delivery US Gulf Nov 16/25 trip Far East.

Brokers were not sure if the charterer's intention was grain to China or Thailand or both. Last Friday Hanj fixed Samjohn Light 71,756 tonne dwt delivery Continent about Nov 24 trip via US Gulf to the Far East at $15,250 daily.

Another impressively strong rate to the East was obtained by Giovanni Bottiglieri from Andre for 50,000/10 tonnes soyabeans US Gulf/China for mid-Nov at $28.00, up from $26.50 reported last Wednesday.
Hanjin paid a solid $13,200 daily plus $270,000 bonus for the 1981-built Navios bulker 69,737 tonnes dwt delivery mid-Nov US Gulf trip Far East.
Halla were rumoured to have booked Mnuri Cerrahou 69,461 tonnes dwt to cover grain from US Gulf to Taiwan but details were slow to emerge.

Cobelfret paid a firm $14.10 for Diavolezza for 59,000/10 tonnes heavy grain Mississippi/Hamburg basis shipment Dec 1/10 and Cargill today quoted $14.00 for their end-Nov/early-Dec Panamax stem US Gulf to Lisbon-Hamburg including West Coast UK.

In the Far East NNC fixed the 1976-built Stef 60,214 tonnes dwt delivery South Korea spot trip via Nopac redelivery Egyptian Med at $7,000 daily, as well as the 1977-built Borsec 54,614 tonnes dwt Forhe same trip, but only lifted subjects on Borsec.
A measure of the difference between the Panamax and Handy market in the Atlantic was Toepfer's fixture of 33,000 tonnes grains 53' US Gulf to Gibraltar-Hamburg range at only $15.35 for mid-Nov.
Glencore were believed to have taken a handy-size for Plate/Cuba grain at $23.00, but full details were lacking.

MINERALS - Little emerged today about Capers. Cape America 149,515 tonnes dwt and China Act 151,688 tonnes dwt were rumoured fixed for business from the Atlantic to the Far East and World Nord 150,903 tonnes dwt in the opposite direction, but full information was not available.
Owners were optimistic about prospects in the short-term. In fertilizer trades, Interbulk took the 1974-built Donald for 55,000/10 tonnes DAP Morehead City to China for Nov 15/25 at a firm $27.00.

In the East brokers reported a quiet start to the week for Panamaxes, but Evgenia 69,000 tonnes dwt was believed fixed on subjects from South Korea and CNAN booked a Panamax for coal from Hay Pot to Algeria, both on private terms.
Klaveness paid a very stiff $9,000 daily for Mount Penteli 63,569 tonnes dwt delivery North China for a trip via Weipa with Bauxite to Porto Vesme.

HANDY-SIZES - Most reported activity was for larger craned tonnage from the Continent. Moller booked Bunga Melor Tiga 43,108 tonnes dwt delivery Skaw for a trip via the Baltic to the Far East at $11,500 daily and also the Furness Withy-relet Anangel Dignity 41,479 tonnes dwt delivery Huelva trip via Baltic to the Far East at a strong $11,000 daily.

Albatross were linked with Bulk Taurus 45,654 dwt tonnes for a trip from the Continent to the Far East at $12,000 daily or more, and Star with the nyk-relet Anangel Power 34,070 tonnes dwt from the Continent to US West coast at about $10,000 daily. Smaller handies were said to be in relatively weak demand in the North Atlantic and most other loading areas.
